name: reminder_set
description: Sets a DURABLE reminder by creating a Google Calendar event that syncs to all Sir's devices and survives restarts. Use for appointments and dated events: 'remind me about my doctor appointment tomorrow at 3', 'set a reminder for the meeting Friday', 'remind me to call Mom tonight at 8'. For short transient timers that should NOT be saved ('turn off the oven in 5 minutes', 'set a timer for 20 minutes') use timer_set instead.

message.description: What Sir wants to be reminded of.

when.description: When to fire, in natural language: '6 PM', 'tomorrow at 9', 'in 30 minutes'.
